```yaml
name: Dev Canary Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pip install pytest
          pytest tests/ -v --tb=short || true

  canary-deploy-modal:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install Modal CLI
        run: pip install modal

      - name: Deploy to Modal
        run: |
          if [ -f distributed/deploy/modal_app.py ]; then
            modal deploy distributed/deploy/modal_app.py
          else
            echo "Modal app file not found, skipping."
          fi
        env:
          MODAL_TOKEN_ID: ${{ secrets.MODAL_TOKEN_ID }}
          MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET: ${{ secrets.MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET }}

  canary-deploy-fly:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Fly CLI
        run: |
          curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.fly/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        run: |
          if [ -f distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh ]; then
            chmod +x distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh
            bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh
          else
            echo "Fly deploy script not found, skipping."
          fi
        env:
          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}

  canary-deploy-railway:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Railway CLI
        run: npm install -g @railway/cli

      - name: Deploy to Railway
        run: |
          if [ -f distributed/deploy/railway.toml ]; then
            railway init --token ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
            railway up --token ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
          else
            echo "Railway config not found, skipping."
          fi
        env:
          RAILWAY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}

  verify-health:
    needs: [canary-deploy-modal, canary-deploy-fly, canary-deploy-railway]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always() && (needs.canary-deploy-modal.result == 'success' || needs.canary-deploy-fly.result == 'success' || needs.canary-deploy-railway.result == 'success')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify Health Endpoints
        run: |
          echo "Verifying health endpoints..."
          # Note: Actual URLs would need to be passed via secrets or outputs from previous jobs
          # This is a placeholder for the verification logic
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.MODAL_APP_URL }}" ]; then
            curl -f ${{ secrets.MODAL_APP_URL }}/health || echo "Modal health check failed"
          fi
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.FLY_APP_URL }}" ]; then
            curl -f ${{ secrets.FLY_APP_URL }}/health || echo "Fly health check failed"
          fi
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.RAILWAY_APP_URL }}" ]; then
            curl -f ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_APP_URL }}/health || echo "Railway health check failed"
          fi
```
